method: All 70 dated feature records were examined under the existing scoring rubric. Existing scores are retained; evidence gaps are named rather than treated as fresh failures or passes. No activity entry grants readiness credit and no new owner acceptance is added. On Nov 8, 2026 the test reports posted since were read against all 70 rows; one score moved on dated evidence (Home layouts and Customize layout, 90% to 99%: AI-tested, no errors found, waiting for the owner’s 100%) and the other 69 are unchanged. A second review on Nov 8, 2026 (Nov 8, 2026, 12:02 PM Eastern) read the receipts posted from Nov 8, 4:21 to 11:36 AM Eastern against the same rows: no score moved and no new owner acceptance is added; the eight rows with new dated results (Pack for a trip, Campsite games, Campsite host start and stop, Opening the app and the five tabs, Library, player and web player, Keyboard and screen-reader support, Jellyfin-compatible mode, Photos and phone backups) have updated summaries. A third review (Nov 9, 2026, 10:12 AM Eastern) read the receipts posted from Nov 8, 12:02 PM to Nov 9, 2026, 9:47 AM Eastern against the same rows: Wireless speakers is 100% on Nick’s own recorded decision (Nov 9, 7:42 AM Eastern, a new owner acceptance recorded on the row); Accessibility choices moved from 99% to 90% because of a new open failure (Read It To Me Resume); the other rows with new dated records keep their scores.
